correctness.rationale: Every ordered pair of insertion gaps over the named set is a possible one-point extension; homogeneity makes any two realizations of that pair automorphic over the finite base, so they give exactly one complete nonalgebraic type. The parameters below the new point are prefixes A_i and B_j in the two orders. Their symmetric difference has size i+j−2|A_i∩B_j|, at least |i−j| and of parity i+j. This gives exactly 2n candidate cells for grade one. The upper cells contribute precisely under A_k⊆B_{k+1}, the lower under B_k⊆A_{k+1}. Saturation gives both inclusions for every k; applying them at the first places where each element enters gives π(k)≤k+1 and π⁻¹(k)≤k+1, or |π(k)−k|≤1, and these inequalities also suffice. A bandwidth-one permutation begins with 1 fixed or the forced initial pair (2,1); deleting it and iterating proves the matching classification. The identity cell grade is |i−j|. For a swap at k,k+1 the second-order prefix changes only at gap j=k; intersecting it with the first-order prefix changes the size only at i=k. So disjoint swaps change distinct cells and each exchanges a zero grade for grade two. This proves the polynomial shift s(z²−1) including the n=2 endpoint. Equality of the full polynomial forces grade one maximal and then forces the same s by the constant coefficient. Subtracting 0,1,…,s−1 from the increasing nonconsecutive start indices bijects the fibre with the s-subsets of [n−s]; total count obeys the path-matching Fibonacci recurrence. The n=4 example follows with s=1. The proof is unrestricted in n; the supplied exhaustive output for n=2,…,8 is finite corroboration only.
residual_risks: Only nonalgebraic singleton types in the stated two-order language over finite named sets are counted. No claim about higher-arity types or generic reconstruction is made.

All-grade envelope's explicit limitation to bounds and witnesses
value.rationale: This establishes what an entire natural type spectrum can and cannot distinguish on the extremal family for the first positive disagreement grade. Independent local swaps can move without any spectral signal: the number of swaps is recoverable, their locations are not, and the closed fibre sizes give an exact ambiguity count over all base permutations. The fibre result is a useful structural classification, rather than just the already shared one-coefficient bound or a collision at one small n.
residual_risks: The inverse classification is only for the maximal-grade-one polynomials; a solution of the arbitrary-permutation fibre problem is not claimed.
